category: hosted feature flags with local SDK evaluation, billed per project

free_tier.stated: Hobby plan, free, no credit card required: one team member (owner only), one environment, up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited flag evaluations, unlimited clients; paid plans have a 14-day free trial
free_tier.notes: Billing is per project, not per seat: the whole team is included within each plan's member limit. The pricing FAQ says flag evaluations are unlimited on every plan because flags are evaluated locally in the SDK. The public pricing page capture showed only the FAQ section, so the EUR 15 Starter monthly price published by third parties is not used here.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-flag value size cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no flag-data retention period is stated on the first-party pages read; a third party lists 7-day data retention on the free tier, which is not used as evidence here

egress.terms: not applicable: a flag service with locally evaluated flags and no per-evaluation charge or traffic allowance published

interface_detail: The SDK initializes with a project ID, an environment-specific API key and a decryption key, then downloads configuration and evaluates flags locally with no network call per evaluation; a REST-style admin API is implied by the dashboard and SDK setup, but the exact endpoint is unverified on the pages read.
tooling: Official SDKs for TypeScript, React, Python, Go, Java and C#; the free plan is limited to one team member.
chaining: Evaluate flags locally in an app from one project using a single environment, staying within 10 newly created flags per month.

limits.value: up to 10 new flags per month on Hobby
one team member (owner only) and one environment on Hobby
unlimited flag evaluations on every plan; no per-evaluation charge or throttling

limits_note: Hobby has one member and one environment; Starter allows up to 5 and Pro up to 15 with extra seats as add-ons, per the access-control documentation. Analytics data from free-plan projects is silently discarded, per the official Python and React SDK documentation.
binding_note: The 10-new-flags-per-month creation cap and the single member and environment bind first; evaluations are unlimited, so traffic does not consume the free allowance.

identity_cost.detail: The register form asks for Full Name, Work Email, Password and Confirm Password; no card is required and cancellation is allowed at any time. No phone number or ID is requested on the form; whether a later step asks for one is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Flag evaluation is local with no per-evaluation charge or throttling on any plan. Paid plans include a 14-day free trial with no card required; cancelling reverts the project to the free Hobby tier at the end of the billing period. Enforcement behaviour past the Hobby flag-creation cap is unverified on the pages read.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from first-party homepage, pricing FAQ, access-control documentation and register pages. No account was opened and no live flag evaluation was probed, so the record stays at documented rung. The detailed plan price grid and a per-flag value cap remain unverified on a first-party page.
